Removes specified HTML elements by CSS selector before processing

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'remove_tags' => ['nav', 'aside', 'footer'], 'respect_robots_txt' => false }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
puts result.inspect
```
